name: Netline Internet Services
summary: Sydney Northern Beaches dialup ISP (Netline Internet Services Pty Ltd, PO Box 615 Mona Vale): PPP/SLIP/shell access at 14k4-33k6 from a Terrey Hills POP; ph (02) 9999 2558 (ACN 097 780 615).

events.details: netline.net.au live by 24 Dec 1996 ('Copyright 1996 by Netline Internet Services Pty Ltd'); listed in the Australian ISP List with a Terrey Hills POP (entry last updated 28 Mar 1998).

refs.label: Australian ISP List: Netline Internet Services (Wayback Jun 2000; entry updated 28 Mar 1998)

events.details: Last Wayback capture of netline.net.au on 9 Oct 2024; site did not respond when checked (Aug 2026). The operator's ABN was cancelled 31 Mar 2004; the frozen © 1998 homepage lingering into 2005 does not extend the ISP's life. operator ABN cancelled.

refs.label: Official cancellation of the operator company's ABN
A frozen Netline homepage lingered to Jun 2005 but there was no operating business
